common_conditions: TS23.280 V19.9.0; EPS bearer considerations, not 5GS mapping
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: Initial-attach PDN uses a different APN from MC services APN
claims.conclusion: Establish the MC-services PDN before user authentication; a SIP registration request can also trigger PDN establishment.

SIP-1 uses QCI69; HTTP-1 uses QCI8 or better. If HTTP-1 does not use QCI8, caution should be used to avoid compromising higher-priority signalling/media by combining traffic. Operator-owned SIP core using IMS APN requires provider/operator agreement on these or GSMA QoS rules.

limitations: No QCI numeric ordering inference, media bearer mapping or 5QI equivalence.
TS23.203/23.401 and GSMA IR.92/IR.88 dependencies not independently checked.
V19.9.0 only; not a verification of the existing V19.3.0 Rx editorial summary.
